purpose: Teach: かっこう/細長い/薄暗い/スグ/熟睡/退散/公私/この上ない

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがかっこうの良いスーツでお出かけよ
lines.en: Sho, your father's going out in quite a smart suit today.
lines.style: Light, warm observation. Easy smile in the voice. Brief — the kind of casual remark a mother makes to draw a child's attention to something nice. Conversational pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと細長いポッキー食べたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I ate those long Pocky sticks together.
lines.style: Bright, immediate. Small excited edge — a six-year-old eager to report something he did. Quick words, no hesitation. The kind of small detail a quiet child brings back carefully.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、薄暗いお部屋で本を読むと目が疲れるわよ
lines.en: Sho, reading in dim light will tire your eyes out.
lines.style: Gentle but firm. The practical concern of a mother — not scolding, just stating fact. Slight forward lean in the delivery, like she's pointing something out he should know.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんがスグ戻ってくるそうよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad says he'll be back soon.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, small happy note underneath. Reporting information he's been told. Calm, no urgency — just relaying what he knows. The steadiness of a child who accepts things as they come.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが熟睡されてるから静かにね
lines.en: Sho, your father's sleeping very deeply right now, so we need to be quiet.
lines.style: Low, careful tone. A quiet instruction with real gentleness — protective of both the sleeping father and the child's natural impulse to move around. Soft opening, steady through-line.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、いたずらしてお父さんに怒られたらスグ退散だね
lines.en: Mom, if I pull a prank and Dad gets mad, I'll disappear real quick.
lines.style: Dry, small knowing tone. Not quite a joke — more like a child who understands consequence and thinks it's funny. Slight self-aware pause before 'disappear.' The ghost of a smile in his delivery.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは公私の区別をきちんとされてるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father keeps a clear line between work and home.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost musing. A mother reflecting on something she's noticed and appreciates about her husband. Quiet pride in the observation. Steady pace, no rush — she's thinking as she speaks.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんとの時間はこの上ない幸せだよ
lines.en: Mom, the time I spend with Dad — there's nothing better than that.
lines.style: Soft, genuine, unhurried. A six-year-old being sincere without performance. Slight fullness in the voice — he means it completely. Warm close on the final word, like he's speaking something true he's been holding.
